title: Finding the New Bus Stop
instructions: Listen to a later conversation on Tuesday and answer the questions.
transcript:
Maya: Leo, the usual bus stop is closed today. How can we get to the new stop?
Leo: Turn right at the bakery, then walk past the library.
Maya: Is it beside the green gate?
Leo: No. It is across from the library, next to the pharmacy.
Maya: What time does the next bus leave?
Leo: At three fifteen. We have twenty minutes.
Maya: Good. I need to return this visitor badge first.
Leo: The office worker said to leave it on the counter.
Maya: I will do that. Could you carry the folded poster?
Leo: Yes. I will keep it in my coat if it rains.
Maya: Thank you. Should we ask the worker about tomorrow?
Leo: Yes. She wants us to arrive at nine and bring two clean towels.
Maya: I will write that in my notebook.
Leo: Great. Then let us walk to the new stop together.
